description: This file contains functions and classes for handling booking period limits, date validation, and boundary checks in a scheduling system, including timezone-aware calculations and period restrictions.

classes.name: BookingDateInPastError
classes.description: Custom error class for handling attempts to book in the past.

methods.name: guardAgainstBookingInThePast
methods.description: Checks if a given date is in the past and throws an error if so.

methods.name: calculatePeriodLimits
methods.description: Calculates period boundaries based on period type, dates, and timezone offsets.

methods.name: getRollingWindowEndDate
methods.description: Determines the end date of a rolling window period, considering bookability and non-business days.

methods.name: isTimeOutOfBounds
methods.description: Checks if a specific time is out of bounds due to being in the past or violating minimum booking notice.

methods.name: getPastTimeAndMinimumBookingNoticeBoundsStatus
methods.description: Returns status on whether a time is out of bounds, with reasons.

methods.name: isTimeViolatingFutureLimit
methods.description: Checks if a time exceeds the future period limits.

methods.name: isOutOfBounds
methods.description: Main exported function to determine if a booking time is out of bounds based on period and time restrictions.
